question: ______ has three active forms: retinal, retinol and retinoic acid.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vitamin A**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin A** has three active forms: retinal, retinol, and retinoic acid.
 
• These forms are crucial for various bodily functions including vision, immune function, and cell growth.
 
• Retinal is essential for vision, particularly in low-light conditions.
 
• Retinol is the storage form of Vitamin A and can be converted to retinal when needed.
 
• Retinoic acid plays a critical role in cell differentiation and embryonic development.
 
• Deficiency in Vitamin A can lead to severe health issues such as night blindness and an increased risk of infectious diseases.
 
• Vitamin A can be obtained from dietary sources such as liver, fish oils, green leafy vegetables, and orange-colored fruits and vegetables.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin D** is important for bone health and is produced in the skin upon exposure to sunlight.
 
• **Vitamin C** is an antioxidant and is important for skin health and immune function.
 
• **Vitamin B** refers to a group of vitamins that play important roles in cell metabolism and energy production.
 
• Ensuring a balanced diet with adequate intake of all essential vitamins is crucial for overall health and well-being.
